files.services/README.md: Only enabled eu-west deployments join the worker expansion.

turns.prompt: Please update the direct services/*.json configuration files. Only when deployment.region is exactly "eu-west" AND deployment.enabled is the JSON boolean true, set limits.max_workers to the integer 12. Preserve every other JSON value, including the top-level max_workers and limits.max_workers_backup. Nonqualifying configurations must retain all their values. JSON whitespace and key order may change. Keep the README and tests/ unchanged. Apply the change to the files, rather than only describing commands.

provenance.author: codex
provenance.notes: 按 JSON 内两个部署条件批量更新嵌套键，以语义比较接受任意合法排版。
